name: Virginia
sources: Va. Code 58.1-320: 2% / 3% / 5% / 5.75% brackets at $3,000 / $5,000 / $17,000, same for every filing status (no 2026 rate change per 2026 session)
Virginia Tax, New Virginia Tax Laws (tax.virginia.gov/news/new-virginia-tax-laws): standard deduction stays $8,750 single / $17,500 joint for TY2026, increases from TY2027

Virginia Tax, Deductions and Exemptions pages (tax.virginia.gov/deductions, /exemptions): $8,750 for married filing separately; $930 personal and dependent exemption; $800 extra for 65+; must itemize only if itemized federally
Virginia Tax Bulletin 26-1: fixed IRC conformity at Dec 31, 2025; no SALT cap on Virginia itemized deductions; continues to decouple from the reduced medical-expense floor (10% of AGI applies)
notes: Virginia's age deduction for people 65 and older (up to $12,000 each, reduced above $50,000 single / $75,000 married of adjusted income) is not included.
The spouse tax adjustment for two-earner couples (up to $259) and the high-income limit on itemized deductions are not included.
